notes.title: Feedback!
notes.content: [p]Wow, 100 unique players in just two days is really AMAZING.[/p][p]The support we've gotten is insane (especially for such a buggy game!)[/p][p][/p][p]Aware of the bugs and silly glitches, we'd LOVE to hear your feedback! Feel free to share any feelings[/p][p]you had playing the game! Who knows, maybe if some of us devs get bored we'll throw out a surprise[/p][p]update... [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]But Seriously, Thank you all![/h1]

notes.title: Release News
notes.content: [p]Hi all! Thank's [i]so much[/i] for all the support and wish-lists.[/p][p][/p][p]As we approach mid-summer I thought I'd post a little news update to keep everyone in the loop![/p][p]Hardly Workin' is under review now! We plan to release the game free to play as soon as humanly[/p][p]possible :)[/p][p][/p][p]What this means? Hardly Workin' [i]could[/i] release as soon as June 28th!! (In a perfect world).[/p][p]Likely our release will be sometime during the first week of July.[/p][p][/p][p]A HUGE thank you to all of our friends, family, professors, and fellow developers for all the support[/p][p]and for making something like this possible. The development of Hardly Workin' was some of the[/p][p]most fun we've had working on a student project.[/p][p][/p][p]While you'll likely not see a release from SleepySlothStudios again, I bid you to keep an eye out for[/p][p]our team scattered in the projects coming up next year![/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for yapping but lastly, HUGE thank you to the entire Sleepy Sloth team for their hard and dedicated[/p][p]work. This has been such a treat, and I can't wait to see what you guys cook up in the coming years.[/p][p]- Ethan :)[/p]
